svg.title: DIA-002A · Seventeen Times Over
svg.desc: An engraved plate of two stacks of coins standing on one ground line, each coin worth ten billion dollars. On the left, a short stack: OpenAI's annualized revenue of about 50 billion dollars at the end of September 2026. On the right, a tall column: its compute spending through 2030 in an internal projection reported in September 2026, near 856 billion dollars. A wooden rule between them is marked off in heights of the short stack. The tall column reaches 17.1 on the rule, roughly seventeen times the short one.
svg.text: PART I · SECTION 2 · WHY IT'S MOVING SO FAST
DIA-002A · One year of OpenAI's revenue beside its projected compute spending, in the same coin and on the same ground.
